description: One line per traffic source: revenue, rebills, LTV, and ROAS where the merchant has reported ad spend. Use for 'how are my ads doing?'. If `spend_reported` is false, ROAS is null — say so plainly and offer to record spend with report_ad_spend rather than estimating a number. Requires the Trace subscription.
name: get_roas
title: ROAS and LTV summary (Trace)
